The bowl looks like a mixing bowl, perhaps 25-30 cm across. The food covers only a small area of about 10 cm, so the serving is small.

It looks like diced cooked chicken, about 25 pieces at roughly 3 g each, which is around 70 g. There are also about 9 olives, probably Kalamata, at about 4 g each, which is around 35 g. That gives a total of about 105 g.

Chicken breast runs about 1.65 kcal/g, so 70 g is about 115 kcal. Olives run about 1.5 kcal/g, so 35 g is about 50 kcal. Together that comes to about 165 kcal. Some oil may be present, so I'll round up to 180 kcal.
